items.title: `ruff check` equivalent to `uv format` for `ruff format`
items.reason: astral-sh/uv#16314 is the earlier, exact request for a uv shorthand that runs Ruff checking as the counterpart to `uv format`.

items.title: Include additional checks, such as `ruff check`, in `uv check`
items.reason: astral-sh/uv#19768 explicitly considers either adding Ruff checking to `uv check` or introducing `uv lint`, including fix forwarding; it is broader because it also proposes combined type and format checks.

related.search_scope: Searched open and closed issues and open, closed-unmerged, and merged pull requests using literal queries for `uv lint`, `ruff check`, `ruff check --fix`, `uv check`, and `uv format`, plus conceptual queries for lint/linter commands, Ruff integration, static analysis, code-quality checks, format commands, and task aliases. No related pull request was found. astral-sh/uv#6308 was ruled out because it concerns formatting or validating `pyproject.toml`; astral-sh/uv#5903 concerns general task aliases rather than built-in Ruff integration.

type_reason: astral-sh/uv#16314 already tracks the same requested Ruff-check shorthand. The explicit `uv lint` spelling and `--fix` forwarding are details of that existing enhancement, while astral-sh/uv#19768 contains an overlapping broader interface discussion.
summary: astral-sh/uv#16314 is the canonical exact request; astral-sh/uv#19768 is a broader overlapping discussion. No related pull request was found.
draft_response: Thanks. This is already tracked in astral-sh/uv#16314, which requests a Ruff check/lint counterpart to `uv format`. astral-sh/uv#19768 also discusses whether Ruff linting should be exposed through `uv check` or a separate `uv lint` command, including fix behavior. Let’s centralize the dedicated `uv lint` request in astral-sh/uv#16314.
